## Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations {#special-economic-measures-russia-regulations .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/2014-58
:::

[SPECIAL ECONOMIC MEASURES ACT](/eng/acts/S-14.5)

Registration 2014-03-17

Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations

P.C. 2014-282 2014-03-17
::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
Whereas the Governor in Council is of the opinion that the actions of
the Russian Federation constitute a grave breach of international peace
and security that has resulted or is likely to result in a serious
international crisis;

Therefore, His Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the
recommendation of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, pursuant to
subsections 4(1) to (3) of the [Special Economic Measures
Act](/eng/acts/S-14.5)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_81000-2-1947-revised-E_hq_13243){#fn_81000-2-1947-revised-E_hq_13243-ID0EDBAA},
makes the annexed [Special Economic Measures (Russia)
Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2014-58).

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_81000-2-1947-revised-E_hq_13243-ID0EDBAA){#fn_81000-2-1947-revised-E_hq_13243}S.C.
  1992, c. 17
  :::
:::

## [Interpretation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810847 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in these Regulations.

[[consumer communication device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[consumer communication device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of
    the following items:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} computers;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} disk drives, solid-state storage equipment and
      other memory devices;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} input/output control units, other than industrial
      controllers designed for chemical processing;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} graphics accelerators and graphics coprocessors;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} monitors;

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} printers;

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} modems, network access controllers and
      communications channel controllers;

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} keyboards, mice and similar devices;

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} mobile phones, including cellular and satellite
      telephones, personal digital assistants, subscriber identity
      module (SIM) cards and similar devices;

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} information security equipment and peripherals;

    - [(k)]{.lawlabel} digital cameras and memory cards;

    - [(l)]{.lawlabel} television and radio receivers;

    - [(m)]{.lawlabel} recording devices;

    - [(n)]{.lawlabel} batteries, chargers, carrying cases and
      accessories for a good referred to in paragraphs (a) to (m); and

    - [(o)]{.lawlabel} software, other than encryption source code, for
      use with a good referred to in paragraphs (a) to (n). ([dispositif
      de communication]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2022-27, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[designated person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[designated person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2024-32, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

[[IMO number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IMO number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the unique seven-digit ship
    identification number required by regulation XI-1/3 of the
    International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea,
    1974. ([numéro OMI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Minister of Foreign
    Affairs. ([ministre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[pension]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pension]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2022-27, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[Restricted Goods and Technologies List]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Restricted Goods and Technologies List]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    the Restricted Goods and Technologies List, prepared by the
    Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development and published
    on the Department's website, as amended from time to time. ([Liste
    des marchandises et technologies réglementées]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Russia]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Russia]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Russian Federation and
    includes

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any political subdivision of the Russian
      Federation;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the government, and any department, of the
      Russian Federation or of a political subdivision of the Russian
      Federation; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any agency of the Russian Federation or of a
      political subdivision of the Russian
      Federation. ([Russie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[technology]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[technology]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any form of technical data
    or technical assistance, such as providing instruction, training,
    consulting or technical advice services or transferring know-how or
    technical data. ([technologie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

## [List]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810860 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Schedule 1

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** A person whose name is
listed in Schedule 1 is a person in respect of whom the Governor in
Council, on the recommendation of the Minister, is satisfied that there
are reasonable grounds to believe is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person who has engaged in activities that directly
  or indirectly facilitate, support, provide funding for or contribute
  to a violation or attempted violation of the sovereignty or
  territorial integrity of Ukraine or that obstruct the work of
  international organizations in Ukraine;

- [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a person who has participated in gross and
  systematic human rights violations in Russia;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a former or current senior official of the Government
  of Russia;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an associate of a person referred to in any of
  paragraphs (a) to (b);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a family member of a person referred to in any of
  paragraphs (a) to (c) and (g);

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an entity owned, held or controlled, directly or
  indirectly, by a person referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (d) or
  acting on behalf of or at the direction of such a person;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} an entity owned, held or controlled, directly or
  indirectly, by Russia or acting on behalf of or at the direction of
  Russia; or

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a current or former senior official of an entity
  referred to in paragraph (a), (a.1), (e) or (f).

## [Prohibitions]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810874 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited transactions and activities

**[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** It is prohibited for any
person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} deal in any property, wherever situated, that is
  owned, held or controlled by or on behalf of a person whose name is
  listed in Schedule 1;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} enter into or facilitate, directly or indirectly, any
  transaction related to a dealing referred to in paragraph (a);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} provide any financial or other related service in
  respect of a dealing referred to in paragraph (a);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} make available any goods, wherever situated, to a
  person listed in Schedule 1 or to a person acting on their behalf; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} provide any financial or related service to or for
  the benefit of a person listed in Schedule 1.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New debt financing --- 30 days

- **[[3.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3.01 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It
  is prohibited for any person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada
  to transact in, provide financing for or otherwise deal in new debt of
  longer than 30 days' maturity, including bonds, loans, debentures,
  extensions of credit, loan guarantees, letters of credit, bank drafts,
  bankers' acceptances, discount notes, treasury bills, commercial paper
  and other similar instruments, in relation to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person listed in Schedule 2;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the property of a person listed in Schedule 2; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the interests or rights in property of a person
    listed in Schedule 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New debt financing --- 90 days

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to transact in, provide financing for or
  otherwise deal in new debt of longer than 90 days' maturity, including
  bonds, loans, debentures, extensions of credit, loan guarantees,
  letters of credit, bank drafts, bankers' acceptances, discount notes,
  treasury bills, commercial paper and other similar instruments, in
  relation to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person listed in Schedule 3;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the property of a person listed in Schedule 3; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the interests or rights in property of a person
    listed in Schedule 3.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-31, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (1.1) do not apply if the
  activities referred to in those subsections were undertaken before the
  person was listed in Schedule 2 or 3.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Oil exploration or production

- **[[3.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3.03 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It
  is prohibited for any person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada
  to export, sell, supply or ship any good referred to in column 1 of
  Schedule 4, wherever situated, to Russia or to any person in Russia
  for use in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} offshore oil exploration or production at a depth
    greater than 500 m;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} oil exploration or production in the Arctic; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shale oil exploration or production.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Services

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to provide to Russia or to any person in
  Russia any financial, technical or other services related to any good
  whose export, sale, supply or shipment is prohibited by subsection
  (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to goods or
  services if a contract for the export, sale, supply or shipment of the
  good or for any related service set out in subsection (2) is entered
  into before the day on which this section comes into force.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ships

- **[[3.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3.04 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It
  is prohibited for any person to dock any of the following ships in
  Canada or to pass any of the following ships through Canada, unless
  that docking or passage is necessary to safeguard human life or to
  ensure navigational safety:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a ship that is registered in Russia;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a ship whose IMO number is listed in Schedule 1.1;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other ship that is used, leased or chartered,
    in whole or in part, by or on behalf of or for the benefit of
    Russia, a person in Russia or a person listed in Schedule 1, 2 or 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Services

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to provide, to a person outside Canada who is
  not Canadian, any services related to a vessel listed in Schedule 1.1.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restricted goods

- **[[3.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3.06 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It
  is prohibited for any person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada
  to export, sell, supply or ship any good, wherever situated, to Russia
  or to any person in Russia if the good is referred to in the
  Restricted Goods and Technologies List or in Schedule 5.1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restricted technologies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to provide to Russia or to any person in
  Russia any technology that is referred to in the Restricted Goods and
  Technologies List or in Schedule 5.1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application --- goods

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} goods temporarily exported for use by a
    representative of the media from Canada or from a partner country
    that is listed in Annex 1 to the Restricted Goods and Technologies
    List;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} goods for use in support of international nuclear
    safeguards verifications;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} goods for use by a department or agency of the
    Government of Canada or of a partner country that is listed in Annex
    1 to the Restricted Goods and Technologies List;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} goods for use in inspections under the Convention
    on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and
    Use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction, signed at Paris,
    France on January 13, 1993, as amended from time to time;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} goods for use in relation to the activities of the
    International Space Station;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} software updates for an end-user that is a civilian
    entity that is owned, held or controlled by a Canadian or a national
    of a partner country that is listed in Annex 1 to the Restricted
    Goods and Technologies List, or a subsidiary of such an entity;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} civil aircraft registered in a foreign state that
    are departing from Canada after a temporary sojourn in Canada or
    civil aircraft registered in Canada departing for a temporary
    sojourn abroad;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the following goods, if stored on board an aircraft
    or ship:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} equipment and spare parts that are necessary for
      the proper operation of the aircraft or ship, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} usual and reasonable quantities of supplies
      intended for consumption on board the aircraft or ship during the
      outgoing and return flight or voyage;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} goods exported for use or consumption on an
    aircraft or ship that is registered in Canada or the United States;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} goods exported by an air carrier that is owned by a
    Canadian or a national of the United States for use in the
    maintenance, repair or operation of an aircraft registered in Canada
    or the United States;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} consumer communication devices that are generally
    available to the public and designed to be installed by the user
    without further substantial support; and

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} personal effects exported by an individual that are
    solely for the use of the individual or the individual's immediate
    family and are not intended for sale or to remain in Russia unless
    consumed there.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application --- technologies

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} technology provided in relation to a good if the
    export, sale, supply or shipment of that good is authorized by
    subsection (3); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any exchange of information aimed at establishing
    technical standards in the framework of the International Civil
    Aviation Organization.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-102, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arms and related material --- import

- **[[3.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3.13 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It
  is prohibited for any person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada
  to import, purchase or acquire arms and related material from Russia
  or from any person in Russia.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arms and related material --- export

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to export, sell, supply or ship arms and
  related material, wherever situated, to Russia or to any person in
  Russia.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} non-lethal military equipment intended solely for
    humanitarian, human rights monitoring or protective use, and related
    technical assistance and training; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} members of the Canadian Forces who are in or travel
    to Russia in the performance of official duties, including providing
    security to Canadian diplomatic staff, providing humanitarian
    assistance and engaging in other activities authorized by the Chief
    of the Defence Staff.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arms and related material --- services

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for any person in Canada and any
  Canadian outside Canada to provide any financial, technical or other
  services related to the sale, supply, transfer, manufacture,
  maintenance or use of arms and related material to Russia or to any
  person in Russia.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[arms and related
  material]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, [[arms and related
  material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any type of weapon, ammunition,
  military equipment --- including military vehicles --- or paramilitary
  equipment, and their spare parts.

  financial institution held by a diplomatic mission, if the transaction
  is required in order for the mission to fulfill its diplomatic
  functions as set out in Article 3 of the Vienna Convention on
  Diplomatic Relations or, if the diplomatic mission has been
  temporarily or permanently recalled, when the transaction is required
  in order to maintain the mission premises;

- [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} any activity carried out by a diplomatic mission or
  for its benefit, if the activity is required in order for the mission
  to fulfill its diplomatic functions as set out in Article 3 of the
  Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations or, if the diplomatic
  mission has been temporarily or permanently recalled, when the
  activity is required in order to maintain the mission premises;

- [(c.2)]{.lawlabel} any activity for daily life and of a personal
  nature carried out by or for the benefit of the Canadian staff of a
  diplomatic mission, their accompanying immediate family members and
  any visiting family members;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} any transaction to international organizations with
  diplomatic status, United Nations agencies, the International Red
  Cross and Red Crescent Movement, or Canadian non-governmental
  organizations that have entered into a grant or contribution agreement
  with the Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any transactions necessary for a Canadian to transfer
  to a person not listed in Schedule 1 any accounts, funds or
  investments of a Canadian held by a person listed in that Schedule on
  the day on which that person was listed in Schedule 1;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} financial services required in order for a person
  listed in Schedule 1 to obtain legal services in Canada with respect
  to the application of any of the prohibitions set out in these
  Regulations;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} any dealings with a person listed in Schedule 1
  required with respect to loan repayments made to any person in Canada,
  or any Canadian outside Canada, for loans entered into with any person
  other than a person listed in Schedule 1, and for enforcement and
  realization of security in respect of those loans or payments by
  guarantors guaranteeing those loans; and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} any dealings with a person listed in Schedule 1
  required with respect to loan repayments made to any person in Canada,
  or any Canadian outside Canada, for loans entered into with that
  listed person before they became a listed person, and for enforcement
  and realization of security in respect of those loans or payments by
  guarantors guaranteeing those loans.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Assisting in prohibited activities

**[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** It is prohibited for any
person in Canada and any Canadian outside Canada to knowingly do
anything that causes, facilitates or assists in, or is intended to
cause, facilitate or assist in, any activity prohibited by these
Regulations.

## [Obligations]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810936 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to determine

**[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** Each of the following
entities must determine on a continuing basis whether it is in
possession or control of property owned or controlled by or on behalf of
a person listed in Schedule 1:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[authorized foreign banks]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  as defined in section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01), in
  respect of their business in Canada or banks to which that Act
  applies;

- [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} the Bank of Canada;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} cooperative credit societies, savings and credit
  unions and [caisses populaires]{.otherLang lang="fr"} regulated by a
  provincial Act and associations regulated by the [Cooperative Credit
  Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} [[foreign companies]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as
  defined in subsection 2(1) of the [Insurance Companies
  Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8), in respect of their insurance business in
  Canada;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} [[companies]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[provincial
  companies]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and
  [[societies]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as those terms are defined in
  subsection 2(1) of the [Insurance Companies Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8);

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} fraternal benefit societies regulated by a provincial
  Act in respect of their insurance activities and insurance companies
  and other entities engaged in the business of insuring risks that are
  regulated by a provincial Act;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} companies to which the [Trust and Loan Companies
  Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} trust companies regulated by a provincial Act;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} loan companies regulated by a provincial Act;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} entities that engage in any activity described in
  paragraph 5(h) of the [Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and
  Terrorist Financing Act](/eng/acts/P-24.501), if the activity involves
  the opening of an account for a client; and

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} entities authorized under provincial legislation to
  engage in the business of dealing in securities, or to provide
  portfolio management or investment counselling services.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure

- **[[7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every
  person in Canada and every Canadian outside Canada must disclose
  without delay to the Commissioner of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police
  or to the Director of the Canadian Security Intelligence Service

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the existence of property in their possession or
    control that they have reason to believe is owned or controlled,
    directly or indirectly, by a person listed in Schedule 1 or by an
    entity owned or controlled by a person listed in that Schedule; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} information about a transaction or proposed
    transaction in respect of property referred to in paragraph (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), disclosure is not required
  in relation to property that came into a person's possession or
  control in connection with an activity referred to paragraph 4(c.1) or
  (c.2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Immunity

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No proceedings under the [Special Economic Measures
  Act](/eng/acts/S-14.5) and no civil proceedings lie against a person
  for a disclosure made in good faith under subsection (1).

## [Applications]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810960 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to no longer be listed

- **[[8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person
  may apply in writing to the Minister

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to have their name removed from Schedule 1, 2 or 3;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to have a ship that they own, operate or manage
    removed from Schedule 1.1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recommendation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the application, the Minister must
  decide whether there are reasonable grounds to recommend the removal
  to the Governor in Council.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Decision

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must make a decision on the application
  within 90 days after the day on which the application is received.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must give notice without delay to the
  applicant of the decision taken.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New application

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If there has been a material change in circumstances
  since the last application was submitted, a person may submit another
  application under subsection (1).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mistaken identity

- **[[9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person
  whose name is the same as or similar to the name of a person listed in
  Schedule 1, 2 or 3 and who claims not to be that person may apply to
  the Minister in writing for a certificate stating that they are not
  that listed person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination by Minister

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after the day on which the Minister
  receives the application, the Minister must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it is established that the applicant is not a
    person listed in Schedule 1, 2 or 3, issue the certificate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is not so established, provide notice to the
    applicant of the determination.

## [Application Prior to Publication]{.HTitleText1} {#h-810981 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Statutory Instruments
Act](/eng/acts/S-22)

**[[10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-10 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
paragraph 11(2)(a) of the [Statutory Instruments Act](/eng/acts/S-22),
these Regulations apply before they are published in the [Canada
Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

into force on the day on which they are registered.

## [SCHEDULE 5.1]{.scheduleLabel}[(Subsections 3.06(1) and (2))]{.OriginatingRef}[Goods and Technologies]{.scheduleTitleText}  {#h-1535655 .scheduleLabel}
:::

- Interpretation

  [1]{.lawlabel} In this Schedule,
  [[development]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[electronic
  assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[energetic
  material]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  [[production]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  [[required]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[software]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
  and [[use]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} have the same meaning as under the
  heading "Definitions of Terms Used in Groups 1 And 2" of A Guide to
  Canada's Export Control List, published by the Department of Foreign
  Affairs, Trade and Development, as amended from time to time.

- Non-application

  [2]{.lawlabel} This Schedule does not apply to goods or technologies
  that are subject to export control under the [Export Control
  List](/eng/regulations/SOR-89-202), unless the good or technology is
  described in item 5400 of Group 5 of the schedule to that List.

  of quantum states, such as superposition, interference and
  entanglement.
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^3^](#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31060-ID0EBB01E0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31060}The
  units, circuits and devices referred to in this Item include those
  that use or are based on superconducting circuits, quantum annealing,
  ion traps, photonic interaction, silicon spin qubits and cold atoms.
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^4^](#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31061-ID0EBB0ZE0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31061}Cryogenic

  :::

  ]{.wb-invisible}^5^](#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31062-ID0EBB0SE0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31062}UHV
  means 100 nanoPascals (nPa) or lower.
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^6^](#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31063-ID0EBB03D0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-4869_hq_31063}Decapsulation
  means the removal of a cap, lid, or encapsulating material from a
  packaged integrated circuit by mechanical, thermal or chemical

  :::

  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^7^](#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945281-ID0EBB0HD0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945281}Medical
  product means a pharmaceutical formulation designed for human
  administration in the treatment of medical conditions that is
  prepackaged for distribution as a clinical or medical product.
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^8^](#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945344-ID0EAB0NC0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945344}All-terrain

  terrain vehicles.
  :::

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^9^](#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945986-ID0EBB0EB0AANBA){#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945986}Items

  specified in item 31 constitutes more than 10% by the weight of the

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^10^](#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945427-ID0EBBPAANBA){#fn_81000-2-5842_hq_1747945427}For
  the purpose of this schedule, nanomaterial means a material that
  consists of particles with one or more external dimensions in the size
  range of 1 to 100 nm (nanometres) for more than 1% of their number
  size distribution; has internal or surface structures in one or more
  dimensions in the size range of 1 to 100 nm; or has a specific surface
  area by volume greater than 60 m^2^/cm^3^, excluding materials
  consisting of particles with a size lower than 1 nm.
  :::

  praseodymium, neodymium, promethium, samarium, europium, gadolinium,

<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> DNA and RNA sequencing
reagent kits;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> library and template
preparation kits;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> cluster generation kits;
and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(d)</span> flow cells.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>

Machines and qPCR (real-time) PCR machines.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom top">3</td>
<td class="borderBottom middle"><p>Parts and consumables for solid phase
DNA and RNA synthesisers, as follows:</p>

phosphoramidites;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> columns;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> solid support resin;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(d)</span> reagent kits; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(e)</span> synthesis reagents.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom">4</td>
<td class="borderBottom middle"><p>Parts and consumables for peptide
synthesizers, as follows:</p>
<ul>

amino acids;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> resins; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> synthesis reagents.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom">5</td>
<td class="borderBottom middle"><p>Parts and consumables for automated
nucleic acid extraction systems, as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> reagents; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> rotor adapters.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom">6</td>

<tr>

in diameter; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> high volume (1 L or greater)
sonicator continuous flow cells.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom">8</td>
<td class="borderBottom middle"><p>Parts and consumables for fast

<ul>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> FPLC columns; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> reagents.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">23</td>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">Centrifuges, including
centrifugal dryers (excl. those for isotope separation); filtering or
purifying machinery and apparatus, for liquids or gases (excl.
artificial kidneys).</td>
<td class="borderBottom bottom">8421</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">24</td>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">Mechanical appliances
(whether or not hand-operated) for projecting, dispersing or spraying
liquids or powders; fire extinguishers, whether or not charged; spray
guns and similar appliances; steam or sand blasting machines and similar
jet projecting machines.</td>
<td class="borderBottom bottom">8424</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">25</td>
<td class="borderRight borderBottom bottom">Electric instantaneous or
storage water heaters and immersion heaters; electric space heating
apparatus and soil heating apparatus; electro-thermic hair-dressing
apparatus (for example, hair dryers, hair curlers, curling tong heaters)
and hand dryers; electric smoothing irons; other electro-thermic
appliances of a kind used for domestic purposes; electric heating
resistors, other than those of heading 85.45.</td>
<td class="borderBottom bottom">8516</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="borderRight bottom">26</td>
<td class="borderRight bottom">Electric sound or visual signalling
apparatus (for example, bells, sirens, indicator panels, burglar or fire
alarms), other than those of heading 85.12 or 85.30.</td>
<td class="bottom">8531</td>
</tr>
